main_text.p: terminus hæreditatis eorum ad Orien tem ab Atroh-Addar, vsque ad Beth-horon superiorem.
6 Et exit terminus ille ad Mare, ad Michmethah ab Aquilone:& circumit terminus ad Orientem, ad Thaanath-filoh,& trafit illam ab Oriete ad Ianoah.
7 Et descedit à Ianoah in Atharoth, & Naarath,& peruenit in Iericho, egreditúrque ad Iordanem.
8 A Thappuah pergit terminus ad Mare ad torrentem arundinis, síntque exitus eius ad Mare.hæc est hæreditas tribus filiorum Ephraim per familias suas.
9 Et vrbes separatæ filiis Ephraim in medio hæreditatis filiorum Manasse,omnes vrbes,& villæ earum.
10 Neque expulerunt Chananæum habitantem in Gazer:Itaque habitauit Chananæus in medio Ephraim vsque ad diem hanc,& fuit tributo seruiens.

page.notes: Printed page number 219; the running head is "CAPVT XVI." with the page number at right. Verse numbers 6–10 are set in the text. Some letters in the scan are faint (e.g. "Manasse" and "Oriete") but read as printed.
